description:
Profile the area within a radius (or a walking time) of an address: residents, households, income, age, and
    the businesses mapped there. With a category, also the yearly market in euros, competing
    businesses and an opportunity score against the region. Use for "who lives within 800 m of
    this shop" or "is there room for a bakery near Calle X". Addresses are checked against the
    municipality they name; ambiguous ones are refused with suggestions.

category.description: Optional business category, to add market size and opportunity score.
category.title: Category

near.description: Address as 'street number, municipality' (e.g. 'Calle Sierpes 40, Sevilla'), or coordinates as 'lat, lon'. Floor and door are ignored and never stored.
near.title: Near

walk_minutes.description: Use the area reachable on foot in this many minutes instead of a circle.
walk_minutes.title: Walk Minutes

name: catchment

mapping_completeness.description: Mapped pharmacies and bars per resident vs the region; under 0.5 the map looks thin.
mapping_completeness.title: Mapping Completeness

market_eur.description: Yearly household spending pool for the category, euros.

market_per_business.description: Euros per year per business (one pseudo-business added).

score.description: Market per business relative to the region; 1.0 = same as the region. None if too small.

thin_map.description: Mapping looks too thin to trust the supply estimate.
thin_map.title: Thin Map

visitor_eur.description: Foreign visitors' share of market_eur (Spanish visitors raise only the high end).

visitor_hotel_nights.description: Hotel nights in the last 12 months by origin (domestic, foreign).
visitor_hotel_nights.title: Visitor Hotel Nights

found.description: What the address resolved to, without floor or door.
found.title: Found

net_income_per_household.description: Weighted by households, euros per year.
net_income_per_household.title: Net Income Per Household

radius_m.description: Circle radius, or the reach used to find tracts for a walking area.
radius_m.title: Radius M

unplaced_share.description: Share of the circle's tracts with no income-atlas figures (redrawn).
unplaced_share.title: Unplaced Share

Source.description: Where a figure comes from. Every number in `data` must trace to one of these.

data_period.description: Reference date or year of the data, e.g. '2025-01-01' or '2023'.
data_period.title: Data Period

dataset_id.description: Upstream identifier, e.g. INE table id '29005'.
dataset_id.title: Dataset Id

publisher.description: Organisation that publishes the data, e.g. 'INE'.
publisher.title: Publisher

retrieved_at.description: When this server fetched the data from upstream (UTC).
retrieved_at.title: Retrieved At

url.description: URL a person can open to see the data.
url.title: Url

Source.title: Source

confidence.description: Lowest confidence across inputs: high, medium or low. Never state a conclusion more strongly than this.
confidence.title: Confidence

title: Catchment around an address
